name: home
meaning: Spawn position copied from ScnObject.pos at init; the twig is teleported back here each time it has drifted disappearDistSq away.

name: frameDelta
meaning: Scratch per-frame translation: velocity scaled by g_dt (Vec3s_ScaleByDt writes through its SECOND argument), then fed to ScnObject_Translate.

name: velocity
meaning: Drift velocity in units/s, hard-coded to (0, 0, -500) at init; the facing angle is derived from it.

name: state
meaning: 0 = wait until off-screen then hide and teleport home, 1 = wait until off-screen then unhide, 2 = drifting. Dispatched with unsigned compares.

name: disappearDistSq
meaning: Square of PROPERTY_TWIG_DISAPPEAR_DIST, computed in place with a 32-bit imul before any range check. The type is s32 (the compare at 0x502ae5 is jge, signed): a property above 46340 makes the square NEGATIVE, so the twig would take the 'reached the limit' branch every frame and never drift.

name: drawnLastFrame
meaning: Copy of inst.flags bit 0 (drawn this render pass), latched by Twig_Render and cleared at the end of each Update, so the twig never hides or teleports on camera.
